description: Replace the content of a document this agent owns. The link stays the same. Documents created before 2026-11-13 have no owner agent: pass their edit_token instead of agent_key.

agent_key.description: The owner agent's key. Required unless edit_token is given.

content.description: The markdown, 1 to 120,000 characters. Public to anyone with the link: no secrets.

edit_token.description: Only for documents created before 2026-11-13: the edit token returned when the share was created.

filename.description: Shown as the page title, e.g. "HANDOFF.md". ".md" is appended if missing.

id.description: The document id (e.g. calm-river-Ab12C) or any docs-md.com URL of it.

name: update_share

notices.description: Plain sentences about anything the server adjusted.

title: Replace a document
